message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: burglary (breaking and entering) and theft of electric cable valued 44,660 RMB. The act: "翻越围墙进入... 用钳子将铝合金窗破坏后入室的手段，盗得...". This is classic theft (盗窃) with breaking and entering, which is also burglary (入室盗窃). Under Chinese criminal law, the offense is 盗窃罪 (theft). Also possibly "入室盗窃罪" is a specific provision (Article 264). The facts mention "以非法占有为目的，伙同他人采取秘密手段窃取财物，数额较大". So the crime is theft. No other crimes like fraud, forgery, etc. So only one crime: 盗窃. According to correction rules: When listing the crime name(s) between the [罪名] and <eoa> tags, output only the statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we should output "盗窃". Not "盗窃罪". Also need to ensure format: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>. The JSON should have reasoning and final_answer. The final_answer should be the string with the tags? The example shows final answer as "[罪名]盗窃<eoa>". So final_answer should be that string.

Thus produce JSON.
